source: MassHealth Drug List (Executive Office of Health and Human Services)
general_rules: Any drug that does not appear on the MassHealth Drug List requires prior authorization (PA).
PA applies to both the brand-name drug and its FDA A-rated generic for listed products.
Members in a MassHealth ACO or MCO plan: the same unified pharmacy list applies to most drugs.
MassHealth members (including managed care plans) do not have to pay copays for prescription drugs (MassHealth Drug List PDF, October 01, 2026, introduction).
vaccines_rule: MassHealth does not pay for vaccines that are free through local boards of health or the Massachusetts Department of Public Health (130 CMR 406.413(C)). MassHealth pays pharmacies for seasonal flu vaccine without PA if the vaccine is not available free of cost. (MassHealth Drug List footnote 1)
